name: Dead Names
source:
A small sci-fi visual novel for Game Boy — set during one winter day, in a future that hopefully never comes. 

[From [url=https://flowerstudio.itch.io/dead-names[/url]Itch.io[/url]]

[摘自[url=https://flowerstudio.itch.io/dead-names]Itch.io[/url]]
